title: Problem Statement and Learner Profile
description: AIL 606 textbook section connecting problem statement and learner profile to a cover panel that names a located performance gap, its conditions, a measurable target, and the decision-bearing learner-profile attributes, reader notes, support moments, and revision evidence.

learning_objectives.statement: Write a problem statement that names a located performance gap, its conditions, and a measurable target
Build a learner profile in which every attribute changes at least one storyboard decision
Separate design-driving attributes (prior knowledge, context of use, language) from flattering adjectives (motivated, smart)
Document how a revised problem statement changes which evidence would count as success

alignment_method: deterministic lexical mapping v2 with direct-evidence fallback; instructor review required
